meta.name: Kemuning Editorial Adventure — Highland Operator Bold
meta.description: Design DNA for JelajahKemuning.com: a printed-expedition-catalogue aesthetic. Paper-ground canvas, near-black ink, one hot terracotta accent, oversized condensed display type, hairline rules instead of shadows, full-bleed documentary photography, and monospace numerals for prices and route labels. Built to read like an operator that actually runs the trips, not like a SaaS landing page.
source_references: internal: current jelajahkemuning.com homepage audit (2026-10-22 render)

primary.role: Deep pine/tea-plantation green for full-bleed dark bands, hero scrim base, footer, and primary display headings on light ground

secondary.role: Field green for inline links, check glyphs, route markers, and secondary emphasis on light surfaces

accent.role: Burnt terracotta for every WhatsApp/booking action, price emphasis, and active filter state. Chosen at this darkness so white button text clears 5.2:1

neutral.usage: Warm paper #F4F1EA is the page canvas; #E7E2D6 is the recessed band and input fill; #D3CCBC and #8A8578 carry hairline rules and captions; #5A5F58 is muted body copy; #333A35 secondary headings; #101613 is the ink used for all primary body and heading text

color.contrast_strategy: Dark-on-light dominant with two full-bleed pine bands (hero, footer). No tinted boxes for emphasis — emphasis comes from scale, rules, and the single terracotta accent. All body copy clears WCAG AA on paper and on pine.

typography.font_style_notes: One grotesque (Archivo) carries both display and body, differentiated only by size, weight, and tracking — this keeps the page coherent and the payload small. JetBrains Mono is reserved for prices, route numbers, section counters, and the legal NIB string, giving the operator-catalogue feel. Display headings use very tight tracking (-0.04em) and sub-1 line-height so they read as a block, not as lines.

spacing.section_rhythm: Generous 96px vertical rhythm between major blocks on desktop, 56px on mobile. Sections are separated by full-width hairline rules rather than background fills, so the paper ground stays continuous.

layout.grid_system: 12-column fluid grid with an asymmetric content split (7/5 and 8/4) for hero and lead package blocks
layout.alignment_tendency: asymmetric — strong left edge, ragged right, occasional right-aligned meta column

shape.border_usage: Subtle 1px hairline rules everywhere; 2px rules under active nav and section counters. No bold ornamental borders except the 1px frame around photographs.
shape.divider_style: 1px solid rgba(16,22,19,0.16) on paper; rgba(255,255,255,0.18) on pine

levels.high: 0 24px 60px rgba(16,22,19,0.18) — reserved exclusively for the lightbox overlay

elevation.depth_cues: overlapping layers, hairline framing, and photographic scrims — never drop shadows

iconography.style: thin 1.5px stroke line icons, no filled shapes

motion.entrance_pattern: clip-reveal on photographs and a 12px fade-up on text blocks, staggered 60ms by index; triggered once via IntersectionObserver
motion.philosophy: minimal functional — motion clarifies hierarchy and confirms interaction, never decorates

components.button_style: Rectangular, 2px radius, 14px Archivo 700 uppercase tracking +0.02em. Primary = ink fill on paper / paper fill on pine. Accent = terracotta fill with white text. Outline = 1px ink rule with transparent fill. No shadows, no translate on hover — background and rule color change only.
components.input_style: Transparent fill on a 1px ink rule, 44px tall, mono value text, label above in 11px uppercase overline; focus thickens the rule to 2px and turns it terracotta
components.card_style: No card chrome. Package entries are separated by hairline rules with a 3:2 photograph on the left (240px) and a text column on the right; hover reveals a terracotta rule on the left edge and underlines the title
components.navigation_pattern: Slim pine utility strip (NIB + location + WhatsApp) above a paper sticky bar; nav items are uppercase overline with a 2px terracotta underline for the active page; dropdown is a paper panel framed by a 1px rule, no shadow
components.modal_style: Full-viewport pine-black scrim at 94% opacity, photograph centered with a 1px white frame, close affordance as an overline label
components.list_style: Facility lists use terracotta plus-sign markers in mono, no bullets, 8px row gap; itinerary lines use a left 2px terracotta rule
components.component_notes: Every component must earn its place: if a border can replace a fill, use the border. Pill badges from the previous design are replaced by mono uppercase labels preceded by a counter (e.g. '01 / JEEP OFFROAD').

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A printed expedition catalogue pressed flat on a desk — full-bleed trip photography, ruled columns, stamped prices
aesthetic.era_influence: 1970s national-park field guides crossed with contemporary adventure-travel operator sites

visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous but ruled — whitespace is bounded by hairlines so it reads as structure, not emptiness
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: bottom-heavy photography anchored by a light type block above; each section has one dominant photograph
visual_language.texture_usage: very subtle paper grain on the canvas only; no gradients, no glass

composition.flow_direction: left-aligned vertical scroll with a right-hand meta column that answers 'price, duration, capacity' at a glance
composition.grouping_strategy: hairline rules and photographic edges group content; background fills are avoided
composition.negative_space_role: structural — separates packages and gives the oversized display type room to breathe

imagery.photo_treatment: Full-bleed, uncropped where possible, natural color and contrast, slight warm grade. Photographs sit flush to the grid with a 1px frame; no rounded corners beyond 4px.
imagery.graphic_elements: Hairline rules, mono counters (01 / 02 / 03), and a terracotta square used as a section marker
imagery.image_shape: landscape 3:2 for catalogue rows, 2:1 for featured package, full-bleed 21:9 for the hero

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate and quiet — rules and text color shift, images scale 1.03
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: title underline draw-in, terracotta left rule on package rows, image scale on photographs
interaction_feel.loading_style: progressive — paper background holds the layout with no skeletons or spinners

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: plain-spoken field guide — says what the trip is, who it suits, and what it costs
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: state the constraint plainly and offer the WhatsApp fallback
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: direct, no blame, always offers a next step

overview.fallback_strategy: disable effects — all content renders fully with CSS only; scroll reveals are additive and elements are visible by default when the observer is unavailable

background_effects.description: Flat warm paper canvas with a barely-perceptible inline SVG grain overlay at 3% opacity on the body only. No gradients, no animated backgrounds.

particle_systems.description: Explicitly removed from the previous build. A tourism operator site does not benefit from ambient particles.

3d_elements.description: No 3D. The photographs carry the experience.

scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: triggered — plays once, 12px rise and opacity 0 to 1, 600ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), 60ms stagger per sibling

text_effects.description: No split-text or typewriter effects. Display type is static; only the underline on hover animates.

cursor_effects.description: System cursor retained; usability over novelty.

image_effects.description: Photographs reveal with a clip-path wipe from the bottom edge on first scroll entry, then settle to 1.03 scale on hover over 600ms. No distortion, no filters beyond a uniform slight contrast/grade.
image_effects.technology: CSS clip-path + transform, via IntersectionObserver class toggle

canvas_drawings.description: No canvas. The prior mist-particle canvas was removed for performance and because it fought the documentary tone.

svg_animations.description: The single decorative element: a 1px route line in the hero-detail that draws itself on first view. Also used for the FAQ plus/minus rotation.

params.animation_method: stroke-dashoffset from path length to 0 over 900ms

visual_effects.composite_notes: The visual language deliberately withholds effects. Three rules govern everything: (1) no shadow may appear except the lightbox; (2) no element may have a radius above 4px except the pill-shaped nothing — pills are removed entirely; (3) accent terracotta is permitted on at most two elements per viewport. Scroll reveals and the clip-path photographic wipe are the only motion beyond hover; both are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion and content is visible by default if IntersectionObserver is missing.
